name: Past time in grey
kurz: In the time axis above the daily plan, everything already past is now shaded grey, up to the line for the current time. The grey follows the clock minute by minute.

wuensche.name: Past time in grey
wuensche.wortlaut: Whatever is in the past in the Gantt display, at the top by the times, should be marked grey up to the current time line

rueckfragen.rueckfrage: How should past time look instead? So far only the time bar above the daily plan is shaded grey, from the start of the axis to the current time. Should, for example, the whole daily plan with all agent rows be grey, should only past bars turn grey, or should the grey look different?
rueckfragen.antwort: This is only about the time axis. It should no longer be grey for the past.
